shared_elements: horizontal register band of repeated motifs (row of birds/animals vs row of rosettes)
stacked horizontal registers separated by bands
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces are organised into stacked horizontal registers with a band of repeated small motifs (a row of birds/quadrupeds in A, a row of rosettes in B) and profile-oriented relief figures. What is depicted differs almost entirely: A shows schematic wild animals — birds, quadrupeds, a long-necked bird and a snake-like head — with no dominant human presence, while B shows the naturalistically draped legs and garment of a large human figure with hands grasping a spear-like shaft above, and the rendering conventions (flat schematic outline vs modelled cloth folds) are unrelated.
